title: A University Senate Meeting: Policy Under Discussion

dialogue.speaker: Chair
dialogue.text: Item three: the proposed student feedback system. The proposal has been reviewed by the academic quality committee. Senator Aibek, you prepared the report.

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Thank you. The current feedback system was introduced six years ago and has not been updated since. Submissions are collected once per year, results are analysed centrally, and improvements are rarely implemented in the same academic year they were requested.

dialogue.speaker: Senator Asel
dialogue.text: Has any external benchmarking been done?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: It has. Three comparable institutions were examined. In each case, real-time feedback is collected via digital platforms, responses are reviewed monthly, and identified issues are addressed within two weeks of being raised.

dialogue.speaker: Chair
dialogue.text: So the proposed system is modelled on these?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Largely, yes. Under the proposed system, feedback would be collected digitally throughout the semester. Responses would be reviewed by department heads. Actions taken in response to feedback would be published and visible to students.

dialogue.speaker: Senator Asel
dialogue.text: What concerns have been raised about privacy?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: These have been carefully considered. All submissions would be anonymised at the point of collection. Individual responses could not be linked to individual students by any member of staff.

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: A provisional budget has been proposed. The precise figure will be confirmed once the platform has been selected. Three vendors are being evaluated.

dialogue.speaker: Senator Asel
dialogue.text: Has the student union been consulted?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Yes. A meeting was held with student representatives in September. Their input was incorporated into the current proposal. Two of their suggestions have been adopted directly.

dialogue.speaker: Chair
dialogue.text: I would like a vote to be taken on whether the proposal should be approved in principle. Those in favour?

dialogue.speaker: Chair
dialogue.text: The motion has been carried. The proposal is approved in principle. Implementation plans will be presented at the February meeting.
